statements.status_notes: CVE-2011-3374 concerns apt-key validating downloaded keys against a master keyring. apt stopped using apt-key for signature verification in 2.9.15 and stopped installing apt-key in 2.9.17. The 3.0.4 source and executable install rules used for this package contain no apt-key program, so the affected key-update implementation is absent. Debian also records that the issue is not exploitable in its configuration because no keyring URI is defined. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2011-3374, https://sources.debian.org/src/apt/3.0.4/debian/changelog/ and https://sources.debian.org/src/apt/3.0.4/cmdline/CMakeLists.txt/.

The 3.0.4 source and executable install rules used for this package contain no apt-key program, so the affected key-update implementation is absent. Debian also records that the issue is not exploitable in its configuration because no keyring URI is defined. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2011-3374, https://sources.debian.org/src/apt/3.0.4/debian/changelog/ and https://sources.debian.org/src/apt/3.0.4/cmdline/CMakeLists.txt/.
